items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: He came right in time to play the first chair, the trombone in my band out there.

ctx.x: So that was probably -- that was Bird. Charlie -- Charlie Parker wanted to break away from the things. He was in pretty bad shape. I mean he -- but he just -- in fact, one time he showed me where he had bitten off half of his tongue, had one of those seizures or something and just bit one half of his tongue off from the middle on down to the side.

And Tyree Glen, remember -- I remember when he first came to California. I was putting -- organizing my band, and one night I was sitting up writing music, and a knock came on the door and it was Tyree Glen. He said, Mr. Barefield, I hear that you're putting together a band. I'm a trombone player. And he was a godsend because there's no trombone players out there at the time. He came right in time to play the first chair, the trombone in my band out there.
Where had he come from, then?
